name: Voskhod
about: Voskhod (1964-065A), a crewed vehicle (Voskhod), launched 1964 Oct 12. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1964 Oct 12), held fixed
GCAT names the site (-) without coordinates; the point is a stand-in
